Looking at the image, the wings are partially spread, but the dark flight feathers are not clearly contrasting with the lighter body in a way that matches the taxonomy description perfectly. The Router may have been too lenient here. The 'Neck is long and S-curved' checkpoint is marked present, but the neck appears more straight than S-curved in this image. The Router might have over-interpreted the slight curve. The 'Tail is short and wedge-shaped' is marked present, but the tail is barely visible and partially obscured by the water and the foreground object. The Router should have been more cautious here.
